correctness.rationale: Independently constructed the 24 signed-coordinate permutations (0,1,2), adjacency squared Euclidean distance 2; 36 edges and diameter 6, shells 36/60/72/60/36/12. Independent complete clique and matching reconstruction: r=2 f-vector (24,96,112,30) with 126 matched pairs and critical c0=1,c2=9; r=3 f-vector (24,168,472,618,384,92) with 878 matched pairs and critical c0=1,c2=1; both acyclic. At r=4 enumerated 17,372 faces, 218 maximal cliques, 93,480 Hasse covers, 8,682 matched pairs globally acyclic, critical one vertex, five 4-cells and two 5-cells. Independent exact signed reduction yielded the zero 2x5 Morse boundary; since the 4-skeleton is a wedge of S4, Hurewicz shows 5-cell attachments null. At r=5 only twelve antipodal forbidden pairs remain (S11), at 6 a full simplex.
residual_risks: This verification is finite for the stated graph, not a graph-family theorem.
